about_the_game:
《Hope Town》 is an intensely challenging rogue-like turn-based RPG. Recruit, train, and lead a team of heroes to explore maps, uncover stories through events, and defeat powerful enemies. Collect materials, upgrade your stronghold, forge equipment, and purge all darkness to restore hope to the world.

  • Over 30 hours of gameplay with HD pixel-style visuals.

  • Innovative turn-based combat: Rotate or deploy heroes mid-battle based on tactics, triggering traits to save allies and turn the tide!

  • Choose from up to 15 distinct classes, each boasting 10 unique skills! Every hero possesses 2 classes and 3 traits, enabling synergistic activation of shared skill types across classes. Assemble your dream team by selecting preferred heroes and forming powerful formations. Your expedition party can field up to 12 heroes!

  • 4 major chapters, nearly 100 map events, and diverse items to overcome challenges!

  • 8 mighty lords, 100+ enemies. Defeat them to craft 200+ gear!

  • Upgrade your stronghold, recruit and train heroes, and claim epic gear by vanquishing lords!

  • Permadeath—Each hero has unique looks, traits, and classes, but only one life!

  • Classic rogue-like features: Permadeath, procedurally generated maps, and high replayability!

"Will countless sacrifices halt your march?

"Music by [乌鸦Producer]"
